sql: WITH e AS ( SELECT toDate(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(start_ts), 'Asia/Seoul') AS d, count() AS enc, countIf(danger) AS danger FROM encounters WHERE monster_id = {monster:String} AND ({allPeriod:UInt8} = 1 OR NOT pre_patch_entity) AND ({heavy:String} = 'include' OR NOT heavy_account) AND ({lv:String} = '' OR multiIf(level IS NULL, '모름', level < 20, '1~19', level < 40, '20~39', level < 70, '40~69', '70+') = {lv:String}) AND ({wp:String} = '' OR multiIf(weapon_tier IN ('none', 'wooden'), '없음·나무', weapon_tier = 'stone', '돌', weapon_tier = 'iron', '철', '금·다이아') = {wp:String}) AND ({ar:String} = '' OR multiIf(armor_count = 0, '없음', armor_count < 6, '일부', '6부위') = {ar:String}) GROUP BY d ), x AS ( SELECT toDate(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts), 'Asia/Seoul') AS d, count() AS deaths FROM player_deaths WHERE monster_id = {monster:String} AND ({allPeriod:UInt8} = 1 OR NOT pre_patch_entity) AND ({heavy:String} = 'include' OR NOT heavy_account) AND ({lv:String} = '' OR multiIf(level IS NULL, '모름', level < 20, '1~19', level < 40, '20~39', level < 70, '40~69', '70+') = {lv:String}) AND ({wp:String} = '' OR multiIf(weapon_tier IN ('none', 'wooden'), '없음·나무', weapon_tier = 'stone', '돌', weapon_tier = 'iron', '철', '금·다이아') = {wp:String}) AND ({ar:String} = '' OR multiIf(armor_count = 0, '없음', armor_count < 6, '일부', '6부위') = {ar:String}) GROUP BY d ) SELECT toString(d) AS day, toUInt32(e.enc) AS enc, toUInt32(e.danger) AS danger, toUInt32(x.deaths) AS deaths FROM e FULL OUTER JOIN x USING (d) ORDER BY d
